overview.title: Macro & sentiment
overview.intro: Overview of the most important macro and sentiment indicators. All data comes from Yahoo Finance (US Treasuries, SPDR sector ETFs, VIX, DXY, commodity futures). An inverted yield curve (short-term rates higher than the 10-year yield) is a widely watched recession indicator.

sectors.title: US sector heatmap (SPDR ETFs, day change)
sectors.intensityNote: Color intensity is proportional to the magnitude of the day change (capped at ±3%).

scenario.title: Macro scenarios on your portfolio
scenario.subtitle: Describe a macro scenario in your own words. The AI evaluates each position individually and estimates the overall impact.
scenario.placeholder: e.g. 'ECB raises policy rate by 150 bp, EUR/USD climbs to 1.20, German yields +100bp.'

ecb100bp.label: ECB +100 bp
ecb100bp.scenario: The ECB raises policy rates by a total of 100 basis points over the next 6 months. EUR/USD rises by 5%, German Bund yields +80bp.

fedPivot.label: Fed pivot −150 bp
fedPivot.scenario: The Fed unexpectedly starts an aggressive cutting cycle of 150 basis points within 9 months. USD weakens against EUR by 8%, US tech multiples expand.

brent120.label: Brent $120
brent120.scenario: Geopolitical escalation lifts Brent oil to USD 120, European natural gas prices +60%. Inflation returns to the 4-5% range.

chinaTech.label: China tech sanctions
chinaTech.scenario: The US significantly tightens semiconductor sanctions against China; Chinese retaliation hits Western auto and consumer goods makers operating in China. Hang Seng -15%, S&P -8%.

usdEur.label: USD/EUR -10%
usdEur.scenario: USD loses 10% against EUR within 3 months — without further shock, primarily driven by Fed expectations and twin-deficit concerns.

aiBubble.label: AI bubble bursts
aiBubble.scenario: A broad re-rating of AI-driven tech stocks sets in: NVIDIA −40%, Mag-7 on average −25%, semiconductor ETFs −30% within 3 months.
